findings.evidence: <select id="dob-day-select" autocomplete="bday-day" required=""> <select id="dob-month-select" autocomplete="bday-month" required=""> <select id="dob-year-select" autocomplete="bday-year" required="">
findings.fix: Use three short text fields for day, month and year, with the numeric input mode.
findings.violation: A date the person knows by heart is picked from three drop-downs, the year from 60 options.

findings.evidence: id="name-input" (Full name) at line 12 and id="legalname-input" (Your name) at line 63 both collect a person's name. Postal code, shipping speed, organization name, contact time, and website are not required for account creation per the form's stated purpose 'Create your account'.
findings.fix: Remove the duplicate 'Your name' field. Defer postal code, shipping speed, organization, contact time, and website to a later step in the user journey.
findings.violation: The form asks for 'Your name' after already asking for 'Full name', creating a duplicate field. Additionally, required fields like company website, organization name, preferred contact time, postal code, and preferred shipping speed are not necessary for account creation and could be asked later.

findings.evidence: <input id="postal-input" name="postal_code" type="text" autocomplete="postal-code" required="" size="3"> (size=3)
findings.fix: Size the field to show at least 5 characters.
findings.violation: This postal code field shows 3 characters, too few to show a typical value whole while it is typed and checked.

findings.fix: Loosen the pattern to accept every valid way of writing the value, and normalise it after submission.
findings.violation: The pattern on this phone field rejects valid values such as +44 20 7946 0958; 020 7946 0958.

findings.evidence: <button id="viewdetails-btn" type="button" style="padding:12px 20px;font-size:16px">View details</button> is placed at line 73, before the fieldset id="row-dob" at line 74, and the submit button is at line 189.
findings.fix: Move the View details button after all form fields, or place it in a header area above all fields.
findings.violation: The secondary action (View details) is placed among the form fields, before the date-of-birth fieldset, rather than after all fields where actions belong.

findings.evidence: font-size: 13px declared by its inline style
findings.fix: Set the field's font size to at least 16 pixels.
findings.violation: The text in this field is 13 pixels, below the 16 pixels at which a phone stops zooming the page on focus.
This web address field is type text, so a phone does not show the keyboard built for it.

findings.evidence: All label elements in divs are unstyled and render above their fields by default. id="contacttime-label" carries style="display:inline-block;float:left;width:140px" which floats it beside its field.
findings.fix: Remove the inline style from id="contacttime-label" so its label renders above its field, consistent with the rest of the form.
findings.violation: The label for 'Preferred contact time' is positioned beside its field using inline float styling, while all other labels in the form are positioned above their fields. This inconsistency mixes label alignments within one form.

findings.evidence: <button id="viewdetails-btn" type="button" style="padding:12px 20px;font-size:16px">View details</button> has declared padding of 12px vertically and 20px horizontally. With 16px font, the rendered height is approximately 40 pixels.
findings.fix: Increase the button's padding or font size so it reaches at least 44 pixels tall. For example, use padding:14px 20px or padding:12px 20px with 18px font size.
findings.violation: The View details button declares padding:12px 20px;font-size:16px, rendering approximately 40 pixels tall, below the 44 - 48 pixels recommended for finger targets on mobile.
